Team leaders Miami (OH) Passing: David McComb, 1,121 yards, 7 TDs, 1 INT, 63.1 completion percentage Rushing: Rodney Nelson, 391 yards on 78 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Maleek Huggins, 431 yards on 24 catches, 1 TD Buffalo Passing: Jason Wright, 987 yards, 7 TDs, 4 INTs, 49.7 completion percentage Rushing: Messiah Burch, 845 yards on 151 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Chance Morrow, 483 yards on 41 catches, 6 TDs Last game Miami (OH) won 28-27 over Central Michigan on Oct. 24. Burch carried the ball 33 times for 184 yards and scored three touchdowns. Clint Walker had two receptions for 40 yards and one touchdown. Next game Miami (OH) hosts Ohio on Nov. 10.
